introduction: Missouri Legal Services connects people with regional civil legal aid programs. Apply to the program serving your county.
description: Missouri Legal Services connects people with regional civil legal aid programs. Apply to the program serving your county.

sections.who: Regional programs screen financial eligibility, issue type and capacity. Public legal information is available separately.
sections.get: Help can include advice or representation for accepted cases. Self-help tenant resources are also listed.
sections.docs:
• County and household details.
  • Notices, court papers and deadlines.
  • Income records requested during intake.
sections.apply:
1. Find the regional program

    Use Missouri Legal Services and How to Apply.

  2. Request intake

    Follow the regional telephone or online application route.

  3. Explain deadlines

    Ask about needed records and available assistance.
sections.after: A request does not suspend court deadlines or guarantee representation.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Missouri Legal Services intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
